1.name: Moisture-Resistant HDF MDF
1.desc: MDF panel treated for moisture resistance (green core), resistant to humidity. Ideal for wet rooms, bathrooms and kitchens.

2.name: High Gloss MDF
2.desc: Factory-lacquered ultra-glossy surface. High scratch-resistant mirror effect, perfect for modern kitchen and wardrobe fronts.

3.name: Raw MDF
3.desc: High-density raw MDF panel, smooth and uniform surface. Ideal base for painting, veneering or laminating.

4.name: Melamine Panel
4.desc: Particleboard (or MDF) covered under heat and pressure with a decorative paper sheet impregnated with melamine resin. Ready to use, offering a fully finished surface that's highly resistant to everyday wear.

5.name: White Batten Board
5.desc: Panel made of a core of glued solid wood battens, coated with smooth white faces. Offers excellent dimensional stability and high strength.

6.name: HPL Compact Panel
6.desc: High-pressure compact HPL laminate, extremely resistant to impact, moisture and chemical agents. Ideal for public/collective spaces.

7.name: Decorative Laminate
7.desc: Decorative laminate panel with applied wood or stone finish. Wide range of finishes for high-end interior fit-outs.

8.name: Hardwood — Warehouse Stock
8.desc: Wide range of hardwoods available in stock: oak, beech, ash, walnut. Cabinetmaking quality for premium furniture and fit-outs.
